summary: Improve agent performance, liquidity oversight and risk follow-up with practical scorecards and analytics. Explore the course outline.
lede: Mobile-money agent-network management uses operational data to assess outlet performance and direct support or control reviews. For operations managers, network supervisors and risk teams, the training develops practical skills to segment agents with scorecards, monitor cash and e-float, and review transaction exceptions. Participants also analyze complaint trends, prioritize field follow-up and report findings through spreadsheet-based dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for agent-network operations, performance oversight, liquidity and customer protection in mobile money, banking and microfinance.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with mobile-money, agent-banking or digital-finance operations is expected. No coding or data-science background is required; spreadsheet familiarity will help with the applied analysis.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
